questions.q: Which dynasty built most of the Great Wall that stands today?
questions.why: The Ming rebuilt it in brick and stone.

questions.q: Who was the first emperor of a unified China?
questions.why: He unified China in 221 BC.

questions.q: Which ancient trade route linked China with the Mediterranean?
questions.why: Silk, paper and ideas travelled along it.

questions.q: In which year was the People's Republic of China founded?
questions.why: Mao Zedong proclaimed it on 1 October.

questions.q: Which philosopher taught respect for family, elders and rulers?
questions.why: He lived around 500 BC.

questions.q: Who led the 1911 revolution that ended imperial rule?
questions.why: He is called the father of modern China.

questions.q: Who was China's last emperor?
questions.why: He gave up the throne in 1912 as a child.

questions.q: Which Mongol ruler founded the Yuan dynasty?
questions.why: Marco Polo visited his court.

questions.q: Who was the only woman to rule China as emperor in her own name?
questions.why: She ruled in the Tang era.

questions.q: Which 1934–35 retreat of the Red Army became legendary?
questions.why: It covered about 10,000 km.

questions.q: Which admiral led huge treasure fleets in the early 1400s?
questions.why: His ships reached East Africa.

questions.q: Which leader opened up China's economy from 1978?
questions.why: He set up special economic zones like Shenzhen.

questions.q: Which palace complex in Beijing was home to the emperors?
questions.why: It has nearly 1,000 buildings.

questions.q: Which former British colony returned to China in 1997?
questions.why: Macau was returned by Portugal in 1999.

questions.q: What is the capital of China?
questions.why: Its name means 'northern capital'.

questions.q: Which city's riverside promenade is called the Bund?
questions.why: It faces the Pudong skyline.

questions.q: What is China's longest river?
questions.why: It is the longest river in Asia.

questions.q: Which river is called China's 'mother river'?
questions.why: Early Chinese civilisation grew on its banks.

questions.q: Which city on the Li River is famous for its karst hills?
questions.why: The scenery appears on the 20-yuan note.

questions.q: Which forest of stone pillars in Hunan inspired scenery in 'Avatar'?
questions.why: One peak was renamed 'Avatar Hallelujah Mountain'.

questions.q: Which black-and-white bear lives in Sichuan's bamboo forests?
questions.why: It spends most of the day eating bamboo.

questions.q: Which army of clay soldiers guards Qin Shi Huang's tomb?
questions.why: Farmers found it near Xi'an in 1974.

questions.q: Which Chinese invention made printing books much easier around 1040?
questions.why: Bi Sheng made the first type from clay.

questions.q: Which military classic did Sun Tzu write?
questions.why: It is still studied today.

questions.q: Which festival is celebrated with dragon dances, red envelopes and fireworks?
questions.why: It is also called the Spring Festival.

questions.q: What is the main spoken language of China?
questions.why: It is officially called Putonghua.

questions.q: Which dam on the Yangtze is the world's largest power station?
questions.why: It is over 2 km long.

questions.q: Which festival in autumn is celebrated by eating mooncakes under the full moon?
questions.why: It falls in the eighth lunar month.

questions.q: Which palace in Lhasa was the Dalai Lama's winter home?
questions.why: It stands on Red Hill.

questions.q: Which roast duck dish from the capital is famous worldwide?
questions.why: It is served with thin pancakes and sweet sauce.

questions.q: What is the official name of China's currency?
questions.why: Its main unit is the yuan.
